serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
MuleSoft's Anypoint Platform is a hybrid platform for designing, developing and managing APIs and integrations.

Uniquely built as a single solution, it includes integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) functionality combined with world class API Management, which provide users with end to end automation, enterprise messaging, advanced user and role based management, services/tools for providing API and integration analytics and management, API design and publishing tools, and the ability to share and collaborate on API specifications, code snippets and templates of best practices.
